notes.title: Defect fixed November 17, 2022
notes.content:
Fixed a bug that prevented Solana from changing her weapon in some cases.

Fixed a bug that prevented the user from resting on the bed in the workshop until the tutorial was completed.

Fixed a bug that prevented returning to the title after completing certain events during the Clear Result.
　*In the previous version, closing the game directly would end the game.
　　There are no elements after the result, so there is no particular problem.

If a recipe has already been created before you get a hint on some recipes, the unknown recipe "? Recipe?" is removed.

Fixed a bug that the required ingredients for the recipe "White Gold" were not as intended.

Fixed a bug in which the number of days required for the recipe "Harigarinen" was different from the number of days indicated.

notes.title: Defect fixed November 7, 2022
notes.content:
・Fixed a point at which some items were obtained indefinitely.

・Fixed a bug that the recipe "Fiamma Needle" was not displayed in the catalog.
 *It was just not displayed and does not affect the progress of those already playing.

・Fixed a bug that caused a force close when swapping recipes on the day of the eclipse.

notes.title: Fixed a bug. 2022/10/27.
notes.content:
Fixed a bug in which jumping at a certain point would not allow the user to come back.

Fixed a bug in which the calendar display would disappear when exiting some maps.

Fixed a bug in which the map would get stuck in some areas when moving at high speed.　

Fixed a bug that "wood" could be collected without limit at some points.

Fixed a bug in which some items had different materials than indicated in the recipe.

notes.title: Solana and Sunny's Atelier" was released.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42915249/570f8c8782754d8cfab5fa61c9b0152da7f81c8e.png[/img]
Thank you for your patience. We are pleased to announce that the Steam version of "Solana and Sunny's Atelier" is now available!


Sorana to Sunny no Atelier is a nostalgic JRPG that focuses on the crafting element of collecting materials, synthesizing items, and completing requests.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42915249/b8fe942a897f3b22450744bd1819f23b20c6f912.png[/img]

*Attention!
This product will be released in Japanese,
and English support will be provided in an update.
Until an announcement is made that English support is complete,
we ask that English-speaking users please be careful when purchasing this product.

notes.title: Bug fixes (trial version) 2022/10/19
notes.content:
2022/10/19

・Fixed a bug in which the tutorial could not be completed if certain items were used or consumed at the start of the game.
